_meta.purpose: Machine-checkable Swiss accounting/tax compliance rules for the b/books Devil's Advocate agent
_meta.status: DRAFT — researched by AI sub-agent against Fedlex, NOT reviewed by a fiduciary or lawyer

source_confidence_legend.verified_fedlex: text confirmed directly on Fedlex during research
source_confidence_legend.doctrine_inferred: standard accounting/tax practice, not verbatim in statute text checked
source_confidence_legend.needs_fiduciary_check: numeric/procedural detail that varies by canton or case — flag for human review before hard-coding

severity_legend.blocker: must not post/close without resolving or explicit override+reason logged
severity_legend.warning: can post but must show a persistent flag until resolved

rules.trigger_condition: Entity legal form is SA or Sarl, regardless of turnover
rules.check_logic: IF entity.legal_form IN ('SA','Sarl') AND entity.bookkeeping_regime != 'double_entry' THEN flag BLOCKER
rules.consequence_if_violated: SA/Sarl have no simplified-bookkeeping option at any turnover level; single-entry books are not valid statutory accounts.

summary.fr: Une SA/Sàrl n'a JAMAIS d'option simplifiée, quel que soit le chiffre d'affaires.
summary.en: An SA/Sàrl NEVER has a simplified option, at any turnover.

rules.trigger_condition: RI/partnership with annual revenue < CHF 500,000 in the prior financial year
rules.check_logic: IF entity.legal_form = 'RI' AND entity.prior_year_revenue < 500000 THEN allow simplified regime BUT recommend double_entry anyway (per b/books design decision, see BRIEF.md sec 2.1)
rules.consequence_if_violated: N/A — this is a permissive floor, not a requirement. b/books runs double-entry for RI anyway.

summary.fr: RI < CHF 500'000 : régime simplifié permis (plancher permissif, pas une obligation).
summary.en: RI < CHF 500,000: simplified regime allowed (permissive floor, not a duty).

rules.trigger_condition: Any ledger, voucher, or supporting document (pièce justificative) reaches or passes 10 years from creation without confirmed retention
rules.check_logic: IF document.age_years >= 10 AND document.retention_confirmed = FALSE THEN flag WARNING
rules.consequence_if_violated: Deletion or loss before the 10-year mark breaches the statutory retention duty; documents needed in a later tax audit may be unavailable.

summary.fr: Conservation 10 ans des livres et pièces.

rules.trigger_condition: Records stored only in a format/medium that cannot be reliably read back on demand (e.g. proprietary format with no export, or degraded scan)
rules.check_logic: IF record.readback_verified = FALSE THEN flag BLOCKER at storage time
rules.consequence_if_violated: If records cannot be reliably linked or read back, the retention obligation is deemed unfulfilled — treated equivalent to non-retention in a tax audit.

summary.fr: Les enregistrements doivent rester lisibles/restituables pendant toute la durée.
summary.en: Records must stay readable/retrievable for the whole period.

rules.trigger_condition: Year-end close event (rapport de gestion approved) with no printed and signed archival copy
rules.check_logic: IF event = 'annual_accounts_approved' AND archive.has_signed_printed_copy = FALSE THEN flag WARNING
rules.consequence_if_violated: Weakens evidentiary value of governance documents in disputes; may be challenged by auditors/registrar.

summary.fr: Comptes annuels approuvés : exemplaire signé et imprimé archivé.
summary.en: Approved annual accounts: signed printed copy archived.

rules.citation: art. 957a al. 2 ch. 1 CO (principe de régularité) + immutability doctrine
rules.trigger_condition: A posted (closed-period) transaction is edited in place or hard-deleted instead of reversed via correcting entry
rules.check_logic: IF transaction.status = 'posted' AND action IN ('edit_in_place','hard_delete') THEN flag BLOCKER
rules.consequence_if_violated: Undermines traceability and regularity of the books (art. 957a al.2 ch.5); can be treated as falsification of business records in serious cases.

summary.fr: Jamais d'édition/suppression d'une écriture comptabilisée — extourne uniquement.
summary.en: Never edit/delete a posted entry — reversing entries only.

rules.trigger_condition: Worldwide annual taxable turnover reaches or exceeds CHF 100,000 in 12 months
rules.check_logic: IF entity.annual_taxable_turnover_worldwide >= 100000 AND entity.vat_registered = FALSE THEN flag BLOCKER
rules.consequence_if_violated: Retroactive VAT liability, late-registration penalties, default interest on unremitted VAT.

summary.fr: Assujettissement obligatoire dès CHF 100'000 de chiffre d'affaires.
summary.en: Mandatory VAT registration from CHF 100,000 turnover.

rules.trigger_condition: VAT invoice missing supplier name/locality or UID number
rules.check_logic: IF invoice.type = 'VAT_invoice' AND (invoice.supplier_name IS NULL OR invoice.supplier_uid_number IS NULL) THEN flag BLOCKER
rules.consequence_if_violated: Input-tax (impôt préalable) deduction may be denied by the AFC.

summary.fr: Facture sans nom/UID fournisseur : impôt préalable en danger.
summary.en: Invoice without supplier name/UID: input VAT at risk.

rules.check_logic: IF invoice.type = 'VAT_invoice' AND invoice.recipient_name IS NULL THEN flag WARNING 'check art.26 al.3 cash-register exception before treating as blocker'
rules.consequence_if_violated: Can jeopardize input-tax deduction absent a qualifying simplified-receipt exception.

summary.fr: Destinataire manquant — vérifier l'exception ticket de caisse.
summary.en: Missing recipient — check the cash-register exception.

rules.trigger_condition: Invoice date differs from supply date/period with no stated supply date/period
rules.check_logic: IF invoice.supply_date != invoice.invoice_date AND invoice.stated_supply_date_or_period IS NULL THEN flag WARNING
rules.consequence_if_violated: Ambiguity on VAT period can delay/deny input-tax deduction.

rules.trigger_condition: Invoice lacks description of nature/object/volume of supply
rules.check_logic: IF invoice.line_item_description IS NULL OR invoice.line_item_description = '' THEN flag BLOCKER
rules.consequence_if_violated: Vague/generic descriptions are a classic reason the AFC denies input-tax deduction on audit.

rules.check_logic: IF invoice.consideration_amount IS NULL THEN flag BLOCKER
rules.consequence_if_violated: Invoice cannot serve as VAT documentation; input-tax deduction refused.

rules.trigger_condition: Invoice missing VAT rate and/or VAT amount
rules.check_logic: IF invoice.vat_rate IS NULL THEN flag BLOCKER
rules.consequence_if_violated: Single most common cause of input-tax deduction denial in AFC/ESTV audits.

summary.fr: Taux/montant TVA manquant — cause n°1 de refus d'impôt préalable.
summary.en: Missing VAT rate/amount — #1 cause of input-tax denial.

rules.trigger_condition: Input VAT claimed on a transaction where only a bank payment record exists (no art.26-compliant invoice)
rules.check_logic: IF transaction.evidence_tier IN ('partial','bare') AND transaction.vat_input_claimed = TRUE THEN flag BLOCKER 'proof of payment alone does not satisfy art.26 invoice content requirement — input VAT credit is at high risk of denial'
rules.consequence_if_violated: Permanent loss of input-VAT credit even if the underlying expense survives for profit-tax purposes.

summary.fr: Une preuve de paiement seule ne remplace JAMAIS la facture art. 26 — crédit TVA perdu.
summary.en: Proof of payment alone NEVER replaces the art. 26 invoice — VAT credit lost.

rules.trigger_condition: Business expense outflow with no invoice/receipt but a bank record exists (evidence_tier = partial or bare)
rules.check_logic: IF transaction.evidence_tier IN ('partial','bare') THEN require reconstruction_file (attestation, pattern-match to recurring supplier, or third-party confirmation) BEFORE treating as deductible; else flag WARNING 'plausibility (vraisemblance) not established — at risk of reprise fiscale'
rules.consequence_if_violated: Tax authority may add the amount back to taxable profit (reprise) if business purpose cannot be made plausible.

summary.fr: Charge sans pièce : la vraisemblance doit être reconstruite, sinon reprise.
summary.en: Expense without document: plausibility must be reconstructed, else reprise.

rules.citation: art. 58 al. 1 let. b LIFD — prestation appréciable en argent / distribution dissimulée de bénéfice
rules.trigger_condition: Outflow with evidence_tier = bare (no reconstructable business purpose) where beneficiary resolves to the shareholder or a related party
rules.check_logic: IF transaction.evidence_tier = 'bare' AND transaction.beneficiary_is_shareholder_or_related = TRUE THEN flag BLOCKER 'disguised profit distribution risk — non-deductible to the SA AND taxable as personal income to the shareholder (double hit); apply Geneva CJ triple-condition test'
rules.consequence_if_violated: Double tax hit: non-deductible to the company (reprise) and separately taxable as income to the shareholder. High-priority flag for sole-shareholder SAs.

summary.fr: Sortie inexpliquée vers une partie liée : risque de distribution dissimulée (double peine).
summary.en: Unexplained outflow to a related party: disguised-distribution risk (double hit).

rules.trigger_condition: SA exceeds two of three thresholds for two consecutive years (balance sheet total CHF 20M, revenue CHF 40M, 250 FTE average) OR fails to meet opt-out conditions
rules.check_logic: IF entity.legal_form = 'SA' AND entity.exceeds_ordinary_audit_thresholds THEN require contrôle_ordinaire ELSE IF entity.employee_consent_for_optout != TRUE THEN require contrôle_restreint
rules.consequence_if_violated: Operating without the legally required audit level exposes the SA and its board to liability; needs_fiduciary_check for exact opt-out mechanics per entity.

summary.fr: Seuils de contrôle ordinaire / conditions d'opting-out à surveiller.
summary.en: Ordinary-audit thresholds / opt-out conditions to watch.

rules.trigger_condition: Scanned/photographed receipt total (TTC) exceeds CHF 400 but lacks full art.26 invoice fields
rules.check_logic: IF receipt.amount_ttc > 400 AND receipt.has_full_invoice_fields = FALSE THEN flag BLOCKER 'above CHF 400 simplified-receipt ceiling — full invoice required for VAT purposes'
rules.consequence_if_violated: Input VAT deduction denied above the simplified-receipt threshold without a compliant full invoice.

summary.fr: Au-delà de CHF 400 TTC, le ticket simplifié ne suffit plus — facture complète requise.
summary.en: Above CHF 400 incl. VAT, a simplified receipt is not enough — full invoice required.

rules.trigger_condition: A captured receipt/bill image is edited or replaced after initial capture without a new hash+audit entry
rules.check_logic: IF document.captured = TRUE AND document.modified_after_capture = TRUE AND document.new_hash_logged = FALSE THEN flag BLOCKER 'capture integrity broken — raw scans must be immutable, corrections via new linked version only'
rules.consequence_if_violated: Breaks evidentiary chain for the 10-year retention requirement; scan can no longer be relied on as equivalent to the paper original.

summary.fr: Original scanné immuable : hash à la capture, corrections en version liée.
summary.en: Scanned original immutable: hash at capture, corrections as linked versions.
